name: 47583-multiturnchat-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine, no KV connector, no offload tier, no router.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, bf16, 8B params, ~16 GB of weights, trained window 131072. The ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, 800 requests bounded, safety_seconds 3600.
workload: Multi-turn chat, text only: 100 conversations of 8 user turns each, 800 requests. A conversation opens on a 32000-token standing context drawn from one of 4 distinct contexts, then runs eight user turns of 256 tokens generating 32 tokens each, re-sending the whole conversation every turn, so the eighth prompt is roughly 34.4k tokens. In guidellm this is `synthetic_text` with `turns: 8` and one prefix bucket (prefix_count 4, prefix_tokens 32000); every length is fixed rather than sampled and sampling is greedy (temperature 0.0), so every conversation has an identical shape and only its text varies.
purpose: A multi-turn chat assistant on an 8B model, one user at a time, eight-turn conversations atop 32k-token briefings, single GPU.
launch:
# 47583-multiturnchat-8b-1gpu -- the launch config, in `vllm serve --config` form.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The eighth turn of a conversation reaches roughly 34.4k tokens; do not lower this.
max-model-len: 40960

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

enable-prefix-caching: true
enable-chunked-prefill: true
